params.name: initiatedBefore
params.description: Filter to only results that have been initiated before this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: initiatedAfter
params.description: Filter to only results that have been initiated after this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: completedBefore
params.description: Filter to only results that have been complete before this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: completedAfter
params.description: Filter to only results that have been complete after this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: first
params.description: The number of results to return. Default value is 10. Any custom value specified must lie between 0 and 100, inclusive.

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor to start returning results from

items.docs: Returns a list of payments completed in the given time range

params.name: qid
params.description: QID of the entity to retrieve

items.docs: Returns the payment with the specified QID
